items.rationale: The docs' loop is 'while stop_reason == "tool_use"': the model is waiting for a tool result. Any other stop reason exits. Trusting the model's text (b) instead of the stop_reason shows M1.
max_tokens means the output hit the token limit, so the response is truncated; the fix is to raise the limit or continue. Reading any non-tool_use ending as completion (b) shows M2.

When the server-side loop hits its iteration limit the response returns pause_turn instead of end_turn: the work is not complete, so you send the response back to continue. Picking end_turn treats a capped loop as finished and shows M2; max_tokens is the output token limit, and tool_use is for client tools you run yourself.

max_turns counts each tool-calling turn plus one for the final text-only answer: 4 + 1 = 5, which fits the cap of 5, so the run ends with subtype success and a result. With max_turns=4 it would have been error_max_turns.

A Stop hook fires when Claude finishes responding, and returning decision block with a reason keeps Claude working and hands it the reason. Raising limits does not make the model check its claim, and treating end_turn as proof of success (d) shows M1.
